about: A four-second tone alone on the timeline, fading in over its first second and out over its last two. A fade's gain is the square of how far through it is, so the tone is at a sixteenth of its level a quarter of the way in, a quarter half way, nine sixteenths at three quarters, whole between the fades, and the same on the way out. The picture is black throughout. A failure means a fade's length, curve or place changed, a fade-out starts from the wrong end, or a timeline of sound alone does not export.
